description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

SCCI is seeking a Software Tools Developer to support Configuration Management analysts and maintain the integrity of hardware baselines. The role manages and develops the Hardware CM database, drawing repositories, and change-control pipelines, while coordinating with Hardware Engineering, CM, and JIRA teams.
Software Tools Developer developing and testing Hardware CM database tools for drawing assignment, revision control, and system baselines

Responsibilities:
• Provide the BMS CM Lead with real-time visibility into the Hardware (HW) CM Database Tool. This includes reporting milestones, schedules, build status, and concerns
• Ensure that all Hardware CM Tool updates are conducted in accordance with Software and CM best practices
• Design, develop, test, and document the Hardware CM Tool progression to streamline CM drawing number assignment, revision control and system baselines
• Collaborate weekly with the CM and JIRA teams
• Participate in continued BMS process improvements including but not limited to software development, configuration management, hardware engineering, and automation
• Be an active technical participant in the Database Tool Review Board (DTRB) is required
• Adapt to changing technologies, processes, and organizational requirements
• Providing timely and accurate information and status updates to leadership, project sponsors, end users, and management
• Providing timely alerts to the designated Government representative on potential issues
• Responsible for maintaining backlogs and providing work item estimations
• Participating in daily standup meetings

Requirements:
• Must be a U.S. Citizen and be able to obtain and maintain an active Secret Security Clearance
• High School Diploma
• Minimum of one (1) year of professional software development experience is required
• Demonstrated proficiency in C#, C++, and VB.net is required
• Direct experience developing and integrating Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and writing Structured Query Language (SQL) functions is required
• Knowledge of Industry Best Practices for Software Development best practices is required
• Ability to work in a fast paced, rapidly changing environment
• Ability to work independently and interface professionally with other government, contractor, and military organizations
• Ability to work with others to meet established goals and program schedules
• Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing

Preferred:
• Knowledge of Configuration Management processes and tools, including baseline identification, change control boards (CCB), configuration audits, release management, and status accounting is desired
• CompTIA Security+ certification or desire to obtain one
• Experience with Power Suite tools and language (Power BI, Power Automate, and Power Fx)
• Experience training users and troubleshooting issues working with host site personnel and network engineers
